name: codech-mockup-design
description: Codech Mockup Design — structured design ideation and visual prototyping workflow. Creates design system documents (tokens, principles, accessibility rules) and self-contained HTML showcases that render live in any browser — no build step. Supports multiple design directions with mandatory 7-axis differentiation, optional interactive Framer Motion + shadcn/ui prototypes, and AI-generated brand imagery via Hugging Face Inference API.
